meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分镜脚本与音频素材渲染成成片视频,并能批量发布到云端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把分镜和音频做成成片视频并批量产出发布
copy.tagline_en: Turn storyboards and audio into finished videos and publish them in bulk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn storyboards and audio into finished videos and publish them in bulk

howto.what: 它会用 HyperFrames CLI 走完整流程:初始化项目、从目录搜并添加动效、编写合成、跑 lint 和 check、开预览,在你批准后渲染并核对输出文件;构建或渲染报错也交给它排查。
howto.when: 当你要求初始化项目、编写或渲染 HyperFrames 合成,或排查构建与渲染失败时,它接管。非交互模式默认生成居中空白项目。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个新的 hyperframes 项目
在目录里搜逐行显示标题的动效
给这个合成跑 check 并打开预览

howto.what_en: It runs the HyperFrames CLI loop: scaffold a project, add catalog motions, author compositions, run lint and check, open a preview, render after your approval, then verify the output file. It also diagnoses build and render failures.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask to initialize a project, author or render HyperFrames compositions, or diagnose build and render failures. Non-interactive mode scaffolds a centered blank project.

say_en.note: Search runs locally; nothing is sent.

say_en.text: Run check on this composition and open the preview.
